title: Song of the Grass-Roof Hermitage, Lines 9-12
speaker: Joden Bob Rose
summary: The main teaching of the Soto Zen dharma talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating trust and confidence in one's experience and perception, rather than relying on intellectual understanding or doubt. This "trust without doubt" is a key aspect of Mahayana Buddhism, which encourages individuals to embody their practice by carrying it with them in daily life. By recognizing that our minds are like vast spaces capable of encompassing all phenomena, we can let go of fear and anxiety and approach our practice with patience, openness, and authenticity.
